In general, however, if we reckon the first 23, 3, or 5 ver-
tebres after the coastal, buther, it may be said that the
cualth vertebron of the Czaraca was from 30 or 33, which
are the numbers respectively in the humanants and dungory,
on 34, 38; and 42, an adult they may be estimain in the
dolphin. We shall see that, in the dungog at least, we are
guided in this estimate by the rudimentary bones of the
polvis.
